# Dependency notices

Licenses/ preserves all five license texts exactly as supplied in the user's
Silent Hill 3 PC Fix 2.8.5 archive: D3D12TranslationLayer, D3D9On12, MinHook
(including HDE notices), WidescreenFixesPack, and WinToast.

NOTICE_PROVENANCE.json records the archive hash, each notice hash and the DLL
comparison. Only dxbcSigner.dll matches the existing bundle byte-for-byte.
The other three DLLs were not replaced. Exact-version notice coverage remains
unverified. No license for Steam006's own code was found in this archive.
These dependency notices do not establish permission for that code or game assets.
The archive's FAQ, sounds, validator and audio helper were not imported.
